caveat: Pre-2023 ordinances were migrated from Legistar; their district codes come from OCR of scanned PDFs. Districts are the change as written in the ordinance or committee agenda; where only the as-introduced text of a substitute ordinance was readable, the City map's district is used. Ward values use today's ward map, not the map in force when it passed. Of the rezonings matched to the City zoning map, 97.7% agree with it; conflicts with the passed ordinance text are kept as the text reads (the Council's Journal of Proceedings backs the text in 37 of 38 checked) and flagged (map_check).

rezonings.value: one point per zoning map amendment the City Council passed; properties.passed_date, from/to district, upzoning, downzoning, to_multifamily, pd_or_pmd, far_delta, capacity_sqft_delta

rezonings_far_known.value: the passed rezonings whose before and after floor-area ratio are both known (the base for the upzoning share)

rezonings_use_known.value: the passed rezonings whose before and after residential use permissions are both known (the base for the multifamily share)

rezonings_passed_per_km2.label: Rezonings Passed
rezonings_passed_per_km2.description: Zoning map changes the City Council passed per square kilometer in the year.
rezonings_passed_per_km2.methodology: Count of passed zoning map amendments (Type 1, standard and aldermanic) per km², by year passed. Ordinances come from the City Clerk's eLMS (matterCategory ZONING RECLASSIFICATIONS); from/to districts are read from each ordinance PDF (OCR where scanned) or the Zoning Committee agenda, checked against (and, for missed PD steps or where only a request was readable, completed from) the City's zoning-district map, placed at the rezoned map polygon (else the Census geocoder), and counted in the calendar year the City Council passed them.

rezonings_upzoning_share.label: Upzoning Share
rezonings_upzoning_share.description: Of the year's rezonings, the share that raised how much building the lot allows.
rezonings_upzoning_share.methodology: Share of passed rezonings whose new district has a higher maximum floor-area ratio than the old one (Chicago Zoning Ordinance FAR tables, 17-2-0304, 17-3-0403, 17-4-0405, 17-5-0404; a Planned Development takes its underlying district's FAR per 17-8-0901). Rezonings with an unknown FAR on either side are left out. Ordinances come from the City Clerk's eLMS (matterCategory ZONING RECLASSIFICATIONS); from/to districts are read from each ordinance PDF (OCR where scanned) or the Zoning Committee agenda, checked against (and, for missed PD steps or where only a request was readable, completed from) the City's zoning-district map, placed at the rezoned map polygon (else the Census geocoder), and counted in the calendar year the City Council passed them.

rezonings_to_multifamily_share.label: Multifamily Rezonings
rezonings_to_multifamily_share.description: Of the year's rezonings, the share that newly allowed apartment buildings (3+ units).
rezonings_to_multifamily_share.methodology: Share of passed rezonings to a district that permits multi-unit (3+) residential from one that did not (use tables 17-2-0207, 17-3-0207, 17-4-0207). Ordinances come from the City Clerk's eLMS (matterCategory ZONING RECLASSIFICATIONS); from/to districts are read from each ordinance PDF (OCR where scanned) or the Zoning Committee agenda, checked against (and, for missed PD steps or where only a request was readable, completed from) the City's zoning-district map, placed at the rezoned map polygon (else the Census geocoder), and counted in the calendar year the City Council passed them.

zoned_capacity_added_sqft_per_km2.label: Zoned Capacity Added
zoned_capacity_added_sqft_per_km2.description: Net floor area that the year's rezonings added to what the zoning allows, in square feet per km².
zoned_capacity_added_sqft_per_km2.methodology: Σ (new max FAR − old max FAR) × lot area over passed rezonings, per km². Lot area = Cook County 2021 parcels whose centroid lies in the rezoned City zoning-map polygon (else the parcels at the ordinance's address range); rezonings with unknown FAR or lot area add nothing, so this is a floor. Ordinances come from the City Clerk's eLMS (matterCategory ZONING RECLASSIFICATIONS); from/to districts are read from each ordinance PDF (OCR where scanned) or the Zoning Committee agenda, checked against (and, for missed PD steps or where only a request was readable, completed from) the City's zoning-district map, placed at the rezoned map polygon (else the Census geocoder), and counted in the calendar year the City Council passed them.
